parsed.rationale: One of the three participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' path prefix. Per the decision rules, a file under Examples/ or SampleApp/ carries a sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the is_sample_app flag value, and that restraint dominates any action signal. Lifting the extension into shared production code would couple production packages to sample-app demonstration semantics. Additionally, all three records carry empty fields_or_signature arrays, so there is no grounded evidence of which members actually overlap across the three extensions on ProcessInfo.ThermalState — any consolidation recommendation would be ungroundable under the no-hallucination rule.
